correctness.rationale: For arbitrary r>=2 positive part sizes, a directly verified five-level zero-mean potential solves L u=e_a-e_b. The eight edge classes and two sign inequalities yield an exact nonnegative current-sum formula F_N(s)+F_N(t). The diagonal equals effective resistance, so complementary column norms equal 1+H_N(s)+H_N(t), and symmetry gives the infinity endpoint too. The F/H score differences and the nonnegative factorization prove all parameter extremizer claims, including the strict \(K_{N-3,2,1}\) difference. A self-contained exact rational checker independently solves Laplacian systems on 131 profiles (3029 full columns) and verifies 95 reversal instances; no finite sample is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The canonical real edge-space cut/cycle endpoint projection norms are natural Banach complementability/flow amplification invariants. Arbitrary complete multipartite part-size profiles give a motivated complete parameter classification, reducing all edge columns to two exact class scores. The distinctive structural content is that maximizing edge orbits can reverse between cut and cycle projections even though they use the same graph; explicit \(K_{N-3,2,1}\) examples prove this for every N>=6. This goes beyond the known resistance-distance matrices and balanced/split special cases; no global projection minimality or broader downstream application is overstated.
